page.overview:
Who is Zenitsu Agatsuma?

Zenitsu Agatsuma is a nervous Demon Slayer who unleashes Thunder Breathing prowess, especially when unconscious, beside Tanjiro and Inosuke.

Also known as: Zenitsu.
